prior_importants.description: The new digit keys answer whichever session sits at the cursor's index. The new sortRank moves rows exactly when a question is asked or answered, so a refresh between reading and pressing can send one session's option to a different worker, with no confirm step.

process_issues.description: Round 5 budget: spawned only review-correctness (2 instances: src/core, src/cli) plus review-security (2 instances: deliver path, store/display) and review-guards, whose gates held. Skipped conventions, docs, context, simplicity and maintainability per the round budget. Also skipped review-workflow-safety: the PR's own diff touches no workflow. Skipped review-spec: no closing issues. No reviewer returned a finding, so neither the consolidator nor any validator ran.

The prior important on the digit-key cursor is still unresolved at 9c472bf. pinnedId is set only on an arrow-key press (use-controls.hook.ts ~391), so until the operator first moves the cursor, it is still the bare index into rows that a question re-sorts.

The guards reviewer did not open some test files that read source (routing-utils, overlap, merge-gate-untested, land, git-diff-client). It cannot rule out a source-scanning guard in them. The PR's gate ran the full suite green at 1cd5957, which limits the risk.
